Definition: from G2889 and G2902; a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan:--ruler.
BiblicalUsage: Ephesians 6:12 is the word's only appearance, and it lands in the middle of Paul's picture of spiritual war. The "rulers of the darkness of this world" are not human officials but the spiritual powers ranged against God's people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse keeps me honest about where the real fight is: not against people, but against the dark powers behind the evil I see.
RelatedTopics: Spiritual Warfare; Satan; Evil and Suffering
